welcome_page.title: Home and work
welcome_page.description:
A few questions about your household, vehicles and work.

Taking part is voluntary and you can skip any question. Your answers are not linked to your name, and no public authority receives them.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

sections.title: Home and work
sections.description: A few questions about you and your household. They help us understand how easy it is for different people to get around and reach the places they need.

questions.text: How many adults (aged 18 or older), including yourself, live in your home?
How many children (aged under 18) live in your home?
Do you regularly accompany or look after someone who needs your help to get around or in daily life? You can choose more than one answer.

options.text: Yes, I accompany children or teenagers almost every day (e.g. to school, sports or other activities)
Yes, I accompany children or teenagers at least once a week
Yes, I help an adult who lives with me (e.g. an older relative, a person with dementia or with disabilities)
Yes, I help an adult who does not live with me

questions.text: Do you have a pet at home that may generate additional walking trips (e.g. a dog)?
Which of the following vehicles are available in your household?
Which of the following do you personally use regularly? (Select all that apply)

options.text: On foot or in a wheelchair

questions.text: Do you hold a valid driving license? (Car, motorcycle or both)

options.text: Yes, but I do not drive

questions.text: If there is a car in your household, how easy is it for you to use it when you need it?
Which of these best describe your current work or study situation? If you both study and work, you can choose two answers.

options.text: Work through an app or platform (e.g. delivery rider, ride-hailing driver)
Caring full-time for a family member

questions.text: Do you have flexible working hours (the ability to choose or adjust your start and finish times)?
Do you currently work remotely (partly or fully)?

options.text: Yes (3 days or more in a week)
Yes, occasionally (1-2 days in a week)

it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#If there is a car in your household, ho: Se in casa tua c'è un'automobile, quanto è facile per te usarla quando ne hai bisogno?
it.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Quante persone adulte (di 18 anni o più) vivono nella tua casa, contando anche te?
it.#How many children (aged under 18) live: Quante persone con meno di 18 anni vivono nella tua casa?
it.#Do you regularly accompany or look afte: Accompagni o assisti regolarmente qualcuno che ha bisogno del tuo aiuto per spostarsi o nella vita quotidiana? Puoi scegliere più di una risposta.
it.#Yes, I accompany children or teenagers: Sì, accompagno bambine, bambini o adolescenti quasi ogni giorno (es. a scuola, sport o altre attività)
Sì, accompagno bambine, bambini o adolescenti almeno una volta alla settimana
it.#Yes, I help an adult who lives with me: Sì, aiuto una persona adulta che vive con me (es. una persona anziana della famiglia, una persona con demenza o con disabilità)
it.#Yes, I help an adult who does not live: Sì, aiuto una persona adulta che non vive con me
it.#Which of the following vehicles are ava: Quali tra questi veicoli sono disponibili a casa tua?
it.#Powered wheelchair or mobility scooter: Sedia a rotelle motorizzata o scooter per la mobilità
it.#Do you hold a valid driving license? (C: Possiedi una patente di guida valida? (Auto, moto o entrambe)
it.#Which of these best describe your curre: Quale di queste descrive meglio la tua attuale situazione lavorativa o di studio? Se studi e lavori, puoi scegliere due risposte.
it.#Self-employed or freelance (full-time): Lavoro autonomo o libera professione (tempo pieno)
it.#<p>A few questions about you and your h: Alcune domande su di te e su chi vive con te. Ci aiutano a capire quanto è facile per persone diverse muoversi e raggiungere i luoghi di cui hanno bisogno.
it.#Caring full-time for a family member: Mi occupo a tempo pieno di una persona della mia famiglia
it.#Business owner or entrepreneur: Ho un'impresa o un'attività in proprio
it.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: Lavoro tramite app o piattaforma (es. rider per consegne, autista di auto con conducente tramite app)
it.#Shared bikes, e-scooters or cars: Bici, monopattini o auto in condivisione
it.#Unemployed looking for work: Senza lavoro, in cerca di occupazione
it.#Unemployed not looking for work: Senza lavoro, non in cerca di occupazione
it.#Not working for health reasons: Non lavoro per motivi di salute
it.#Do you have flexible working hours (the: Hai un orario di lavoro flessibile, cioè puoi scegliere o modificare l’orario di inizio e fine?
it.#Do you currently work remotely (partly: Attualmente lavori da remoto, parzialmente o completamente?
it.#Yes (3 days or more in a week): Sì (3 o più giorni alla settimana)
it.#Do you have a pet at home that may gene: Hai un animale domestico che può comportare ulteriori spostamenti a piedi (ad es. un cane)?
it.#Which of the following do you personall: Quali tra questi modi di spostarti usi personalmente con regolarità? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#On foot or in a wheelchair: A piedi o in sedia a rotelle
it.#<p>A few questions about your household:
Alcune domande su chi vive con te, sui veicoli e sul lavoro.

La partecipazione è volontaria e puoi saltare qualsiasi domanda. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome e non vengono inviate a nessuna amministrazione pubblica.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity

fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#If there is a car in your household, ho: S’il y a une voiture dans votre foyer, dans quelle mesure vous est-il facile de l’utiliser quand vous en avez besoin ?
fr.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Combien de personnes adultes (de 18 ans ou plus), y compris vous, vivent dans votre logement ?
fr.#How many children (aged under 18) live: Combien d’enfants (de moins de 18 ans) vivent dans votre logement ?
fr.#Do you regularly accompany or look afte: Accompagnez-vous ou aidez-vous régulièrement une personne qui a besoin de votre aide pour se déplacer ou dans la vie quotidienne ? Vous pouvez choisir plusieurs réponses.
fr.#Yes, I accompany children or teenagers: Oui, j’accompagne des enfants ou des jeunes presque tous les jours (par ex. à l’école, au sport ou à d’autres activités)
Oui, j’accompagne des enfants ou des jeunes au moins une fois par semaine
fr.#Yes, I help an adult who lives with me: Oui, j’aide une personne adulte qui vit avec moi (par ex. une personne âgée de ma famille, une personne atteinte de démence ou en situation de handicap)
fr.#Yes, I help an adult who does not live: Oui, j’aide une personne adulte qui ne vit pas avec moi
fr.#Which of the following vehicles are ava: Lesquels des véhicules suivants sont disponibles dans votre foyer ?
fr.#Powered wheelchair or mobility scooter: Fauteuil roulant électrique ou scooter de mobilité
fr.#Do you hold a valid driving license? (C: Avez-vous un permis de conduire valide ? (Voiture, moto ou les deux)
fr.#Yes, but I do not drive: Oui, mais je ne conduis pas
fr.#Which of these best describe your curre: Laquelle de ces situations décrit le mieux votre activité professionnelle ou vos études actuelles ? Si vous étudiez et travaillez, vous pouvez choisir deux réponses.
fr.#Self-employed or freelance (full-time): Travail indépendant ou en freelance (temps plein)
fr.#Self-employed or freelance (part-time): Travail indépendant ou en freelance (temps partiel)
fr.#<p>A few questions about you and your h: Quelques questions sur vous et votre foyer. Elles nous aident à comprendre dans quelle mesure il est facile, pour différentes personnes, de se déplacer et de rejoindre les lieux dont elles ont besoin.
fr.#Caring full-time for a family member: Soins à temps plein à une personne de la famille
fr.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: Travail via une application ou une plateforme (par ex. livraisons à domicile, transport de personnes en VTC)
fr.#Shared bikes, e-scooters or cars: Vélos, trottinettes ou voitures en partage
fr.#Unemployed looking for work: Sans emploi et à la recherche d’un emploi
fr.#Unemployed not looking for work: Sans emploi et ne recherchant pas d’emploi
fr.#Not working for health reasons: Sans activité professionnelle pour raison de santé
fr.#Do you have flexible working hours (the: Avez-vous des horaires de travail flexibles, c’est-à-dire pouvez-vous choisir ou modifier vos heures de début et de fin ?
fr.#Somewhat (within a 1-2 hour window): En partie (avec une marge de 1 à 2 heures)
fr.#Do you currently work remotely (partly: Travaillez-vous actuellement à distance, en partie ou entièrement ?
fr.#Yes (3 days or more in a week): Oui (3 jours ou plus par semaine)
fr.#Yes, occasionally (1-2 days in a week): Oui, occasionnellement (1 à 2 jours par semaine)
fr.#Person with a speech bubble: Personne avec une bulle de dialogue
fr.#Do you have a pet at home that may gene: Avez-vous un animal domestique qui peut entraîner des déplacements supplémentaires à pied, par exemple un chien ?
fr.#Which of the following do you personall: Parmi les modes suivants, lesquels utilisez-vous personnellement de façon régulière ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#On foot or in a wheelchair: À pied ou en fauteuil roulant
fr.#<p>A few questions about your household:
Quelques questions sur votre foyer, vos véhicules et votre travail.

La participation est volontaire et vous pouvez passer n’importe quelle question. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom et ne sont transmises à aucune administration.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

de.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Ihre Antwort wurde gespeichert. Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich Zeit für diesen Fragebogen genommen haben.
de.#If there is a car in your household, ho: Falls es in Ihrem Haushalt ein Auto gibt: Wie leicht können Sie es nutzen, wenn Sie es brauchen?
de.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Wie viele Erwachsene (ab 18 Jahren), Sie selbst eingeschlossen, leben in Ihrem Haushalt?
de.#How many children (aged under 18) live: Wie viele Kinder (unter 18 Jahren) leben in Ihrem Haushalt?
de.#Do you regularly accompany or look afte: Begleiten oder unterstützen Sie regelmäßig eine Person, die Ihre Hilfe braucht, um unterwegs zu sein oder den Alltag zu bewältigen? Sie können mehrere Antworten auswählen.
de.#Yes, I accompany children or teenagers: Ja, ich begleite fast täglich Kinder oder Jugendliche (z. B. zur Schule, zum Sport oder zu anderen Aktivitäten)
Ja, ich begleite mindestens einmal pro Woche Kinder oder Jugendliche
de.#Yes, I help an adult who lives with me: Ja, ich helfe einer erwachsenen Person, die mit mir lebt (z. B. einem älteren Familienmitglied, einer Person mit Demenz oder mit Behinderung)
de.#Yes, I help an adult who does not live: Ja, ich helfe einer erwachsenen Person, die nicht mit mir zusammenlebt
de.#Which of the following vehicles are ava: Welche der folgenden Fahrzeuge stehen Ihrem Haushalt zur Verfügung?
de.#Do you hold a valid driving license? (C: Haben Sie einen gültigen Führerschein? (Auto, Motorrad oder beides)
de.#Yes, but I do not drive: Ja, aber ich fahre nicht selbst
de.#Which of these best describe your curre: Welche dieser Angaben beschreibt Ihre aktuelle Arbeits- oder Ausbildungssituation am besten? Wenn Sie sowohl lernen oder studieren als auch arbeiten, können Sie zwei Antworten auswählen.
de.#<p>A few questions about you and your h: Einige Fragen zu Ihrer Person und Ihrem Haushalt. Sie helfen uns zu verstehen, wie leicht es für verschiedene Menschen ist, unterwegs zu sein und die Orte zu erreichen, die sie brauchen.
de.#Caring full-time for a family member: Pflege oder Betreuung eines Familienmitglieds in Vollzeit
de.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: Arbeit über eine App oder Plattform (z. B. Essenslieferungen, Fahrdienste über eine App)
de.#Do you have flexible working hours (the: Haben Sie flexible Arbeitszeiten, also können Sie Beginn und Ende Ihrer Arbeitszeit selbst wählen oder anpassen?
de.#Difficult (often unavailable or shared): Schwierig (oft nicht verfügbar oder wird geteilt)
de.#Do you currently work remotely (partly: Arbeiten Sie derzeit teilweise oder vollständig von zu Hause oder einem anderen Ort aus?
de.#Yes (3 days or more in a week): Ja (3 Tage oder mehr pro Woche)
de.#Do you have a pet at home that may gene: Haben Sie ein Haustier, das zusätzliche Wege zu Fuß verursachen kann, zum Beispiel einen Hund?
de.#Which of the following do you personall: Welche der folgenden Möglichkeiten nutzen Sie persönlich regelmäßig? (Wählen Sie alles Zutreffende aus)
de.#<p>A few questions about your household:
Einige Fragen zu Ihrem Haushalt, Ihren Fahrzeugen und Ihrer Arbeit.

Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig und Sie können jede Frage überspringen. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft und an keine Behörde weitergegeben.

Mehr über SmartUrbanity erfahren

tr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Yanıtınız kaydedildi. Bu anketi doldurmak için zaman ayırdığınız için teşekkür ederiz.
tr.#If there is a car in your household, ho: Hanenizde bir otomobil varsa, ihtiyaç duyduğunuzda onu kullanmanız ne kadar kolay?
tr.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: Siz dahil, evinizde kaç yetişkin (18 yaş ve üzeri) yaşıyor?
tr.#How many children (aged under 18) live: Evinizde kaç çocuk (18 yaş altı) yaşıyor?
tr.#Do you regularly accompany or look afte: Ulaşımda veya günlük yaşamda yardımınıza ihtiyaç duyan birine düzenli olarak eşlik ediyor ya da bakıyor musunuz? Birden fazla yanıt seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#Yes, I accompany children or teenagers: Evet, neredeyse her gün çocuklara veya gençlere eşlik ediyorum (ör. okula, spora veya diğer etkinliklere)
Evet, en az haftada bir kez çocuklara veya gençlere eşlik ediyorum
tr.#Yes, I help an adult who lives with me: Evet, benimle yaşayan bir yetişkine yardım ediyorum (örn. yaşlı bir akraba, demansı olan veya engelli bir kişi)
tr.#Yes, I help an adult who does not live: Evet, benimle birlikte yaşamayan bir yetişkine yardım ediyorum
tr.#Powered wheelchair or mobility scooter: Akülü tekerlekli sandalye veya mobilite skuteri
tr.#Do you hold a valid driving license? (C: Geçerli bir sürücü belgeniz var mı? (Otomobil, motosiklet veya her ikisi)
tr.#Which of these best describe your curre: Aşağıdakilerden hangisi şu anki çalışma veya öğrenim durumunuzu en iyi tanımlar? Hem okuyor hem çalışıyorsanız iki yanıt seçebilirsiniz.
tr.#Occasional or on-call work: Ara sıra veya çağrı üzerine çalışıyorum
tr.#Self-employed or freelance (full-time): Kendi hesabıma veya serbest çalışıyorum (tam zamanlı)
tr.#Self-employed or freelance (part-time): Kendi hesabıma veya serbest çalışıyorum (yarı zamanlı)
tr.#<p>A few questions about you and your h: Siz ve haneniz hakkında birkaç soru. Bu sorular, farklı kişilerin şehirde dolaşmasının ve ihtiyaç duydukları yerlere ulaşmasının ne kadar kolay olduğunu anlamamıza yardımcı olur.
tr.#Caring full-time for a family member: Tam zamanlı olarak bir aile üyesine bakıyorum
tr.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: Bir uygulama veya platform üzerinden çalışıyorum (ör. kurye, araç çağırma uygulaması sürücüsü)
tr.#Do you have flexible working hours (the: Esnek çalışma saatleriniz var mı? Yani işe başlama ve bitiş saatlerinizi seçebiliyor veya değiştirebiliyor musunuz?
tr.#Difficult (often unavailable or shared): Zor (sık sık kullanılamıyor veya başkalarıyla paylaşılıyor)
tr.#Do you currently work remotely (partly: Şu anda kısmen veya tamamen uzaktan çalışıyor musunuz?
tr.#Do you have a pet at home that may gene: Evde ek yürüme ihtiyacı doğurabilecek bir evcil hayvanınız var mı? Örneğin bir köpek.
tr.#Which of the following do you personall: Aşağıdakilerden hangilerini düzenli olarak kendiniz kullanıyorsunuz? (Uygun olanların tümünü seçin)
tr.#<p>A few questions about your household:
Haneniz, araçlarınız ve işiniz hakkında birkaç soru.

Katılım gönüllüdür ve istediğiniz soruyu atlayabilirsiniz. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez ve hiçbir kamu kurumuna gönderilmez.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin

fa.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: پاسخ شما ثبت شد. از وقتی که برای تکمیل این پرسشنامه گذاشتید سپاسگزاریم.
fa.#If there is a car in your household, ho: اگر در خانواده شما خودرو وجود دارد، استفاده از آن هنگام نیاز برای شما چقدر آسان است؟
fa.#How many adults (aged 18 or older), inc: چند بزرگسال (۱۸ سال یا بیشتر)، از جمله خودتان، در خانه شما زندگی می‌کنند؟
fa.#How many children (aged under 18) live: چند کودک (زیر ۱۸ سال) در خانه شما زندگی می‌کنند؟
fa.#Do you regularly accompany or look afte: آیا به طور منظم کسی را که برای جابه‌جایی یا در زندگی روزمره به کمک شما نیاز دارد همراهی می‌کنید یا از او مراقبت می‌کنید؟ می‌توانید بیش از یک پاسخ انتخاب کنید.
fa.#Yes, I accompany children or teenagers: بله، تقریباً هر روز کودکان یا نوجوانان را همراهی می‌کنم (مثلاً به مدرسه، ورزش یا فعالیت‌های دیگر)
بله، حداقل هفته‌ای یک بار کودکان یا نوجوانان را همراهی می‌کنم
fa.#Yes, I help an adult who lives with me: بله، به بزرگسالی که با من زندگی می‌کند کمک می‌کنم (مثلاً یکی از بستگان سالمند، فردی مبتلا به زوال عقل یا دارای معلولیت)
fa.#Yes, I help an adult who does not live: بله، به بزرگسالی که با من زندگی نمی‌کند کمک می‌کنم
fa.#Which of the following vehicles are ava: کدام یک از وسایل نقلیه زیر در خانواده شما در دسترس است؟
fa.#Powered wheelchair or mobility scooter: ویلچر برقی یا اسکوتر ویژه افراد دارای محدودیت حرکتی
fa.#Do you hold a valid driving license? (C: آیا گواهینامه رانندگی معتبر دارید؟ (خودرو، موتورسیکلت یا هر دو)
fa.#Which of these best describe your curre: کدام یک از این گزینه‌ها وضعیت فعلی کار یا تحصیل شما را بهتر توصیف می‌کند؟ اگر هم تحصیل می‌کنید و هم کار، می‌توانید دو پاسخ انتخاب کنید.
fa.#Student (school, university or training: در حال تحصیل (مدرسه، دانشگاه یا دوره آموزشی)
fa.#<p>A few questions about you and your h: چند پرسش درباره شما و خانواده‌تان. این پرسش‌ها به ما کمک می‌کنند بفهمیم رفت‌وآمد و رسیدن به مکان‌های مورد نیاز برای افراد مختلف چقدر آسان است.
fa.#Caring full-time for a family member: مراقبت تمام‌وقت از یکی از اعضای خانواده
fa.#Work through an app or platform (e.g. d: کار از طریق اپلیکیشن یا پلتفرم (مثلاً پیک تحویل سفارش، رانندگی در تاکسی اینترنتی)
fa.#Unemployed not looking for work: بیکار و در حال حاضر جویای کار نیستم
fa.#Not working for health reasons: به دلیل مسائل سلامتی کار نمی‌کنم
fa.#Do you have flexible working hours (the: آیا ساعت کاری انعطاف‌پذیر دارید، یعنی می‌توانید زمان شروع و پایان کار را انتخاب یا تنظیم کنید؟
fa.#Very difficult (rarely available): بسیار دشوار (به ندرت در دسترس است)
fa.#Difficult (often unavailable or shared): دشوار (اغلب در دسترس نیست یا مشترک است)
fa.#Very easy (almost always available): بسیار آسان (تقریباً همیشه در دسترس است)
fa.#Do you currently work remotely (partly: آیا در حال حاضر بخشی یا تمام کار خود را از راه دور انجام می‌دهید؟
fa.#Yes (3 days or more in a week): بله (۳ روز یا بیشتر در هفته)
